_readme: Which scene fills which store slot, in which theme, with which caption. Order = store order (the first three show in App Store search results). 'scene' + 'theme' name the capture store/captures/<device>/<scene>_<theme>.png; 'copy' is a key in store/copy/copy.json; 'why' says why the caption is true of this exact screen. If you cannot write an honest 'why', drop the scene. 'statusBar': 'light' draws white status-bar glyphs on a light-theme capture whose top strip is dark. Lists: 'phone' (iPhone, Android phone), 'tablet' (iPad, Android tablet).

phone.why: Perseverance's feed on sol 22: raw Mastcam-Z frames under a date header, each labelled with its camera; the sol chip steps day by day.
The Missions screen reads '8 missions · 2 active' and lists Perseverance, Ingenuity, InSight, Curiosity and the rest, each with its photo count: eight missions in one app.
Viking 1's feed opens on Sol 0, Jul 20, 1976, and its first tile is labelled 'First Lander 1 Image': the first photograph taken on the surface of Mars.
The full-screen viewer on a real Perseverance Mastcam-Z photo (sol 48) from the Popular feed, with save, share, favorite and info actions; the viewer zooms with a pinch.
Perseverance's mission screen: launch, landing and current day on a timeline, then total photos, sols and Earth days as statistics.
The 'Jump to a date' sheet over Perseverance's feed: a sol slider and an Earth-date picker kept in sync, with a 'Go to Sol' button for the chosen day.
Favorites with 12 saved photos, their view counts, a 'Recent' sort and 'All 12 / Perseverance 2' mission chips: saved photos, sorted by mission.
The Filters sheet over Perseverance's feed lists the rover's cameras as chips: FHAZ, RHAZ, NAVCAM, MCZ (Mastcam-Z), SHERLOC, SUPERCAM, SKYCAM.
